canonical_lp.form: Equivalent undirected LP for ordered-pair weights: maximize sum_e x_e*(1-eps_hi_e) subject to each known service having incident weight sum 1 and x_e >= 0; the open-set reported floor divides by M=K+1.

controls.purpose: Reproduce known submitted values from the existing canonical eps_hi before reporting the changed Eq(9) radius.

guarantee_statement.aggregate: The uniform and LP aggregates are high-probability lower bounds to the extent they use the simultaneous upper-side event; lower-side values are included only as bracket endpoints and invariant checks, not as inputs to the error-floor aggregation.
guarantee_statement.lower_side: eps_lo is copied from q1_eps_lo_symbol_map.json and retains that ledger's classifier-based nominal/asymptotic lower-side status; it is not upgraded by this run.
guarantee_statement.upper_side: Finite-sample m-free Hoeffding upper bound, alpha_pair=0.05/990; Bonferroni gives simultaneous upper-side coverage at least 0.95 over 990 pairs.

lp_aggregation.form: Equivalent undirected LP for ordered-pair weights: maximize sum_e x_e*(1-eps_hi_e) subject to each known service having incident weight sum 1 and x_e >= 0; the open-set reported floor divides by M=K+1.

per_service_min_diagnostic.note: Diagnostic only. The paper's 0.186 aggregation is the complete-graph uniform sum S/[M(M-1)], not the average of per-service minima.

falsifier.criterion: uniform_floor_M46_open_set > 0 under the 990-pair Bonferroni Eq(9) upper side
falsifier.statement: PASS: the joint high-probability Eq(9) uniform floor is strictly positive.
